pathway: Fictional preventive-health blood sample panel; no clinical results
deadline_policy: Request timestamp plus 10 calendar days, fixed at request; disruptions never extend deadlines retrospectively.
stage_semantics: Each stage is a responsibility interval: request intake; appointment scheduling through collection; transport through laboratory receipt; laboratory queue plus analysis; medical queue plus review; report publication. Completion and next entry coincide. Laboratory work_started events distinguish queue from service. Final stage completion is actual delivery.

normal.label: Normal Operations
normal.design: Stable intake with sufficient laboratory capacity; occasional scheduling and receipt exceptions, with some causes unrecorded.

demand.label: Growing Demand
demand.design: Intake accelerates from 10 to 38 cases weekly against three fixed laboratory slots (approximately 22 cases weekly). Service times match the normal pathway. Early demand fits capacity; later growth creates a FIFO queue. Original deadlines stay fixed.

disruption.label: Operational Disruption
disruption.design: A courier suspension holds North Clinic specimens in validated refrigerated storage. At cutoff, restart is an estimate rather than a recorded future event. Other routes operate normally.
